name: Wild Wood Adventure Play, Crathes Castle
description: Wild Wood adventure play, with the Green Lady's Tower, a rock face, a zip wire, slides, sandpits and high and see-through walkways.
fee: Non-members pay for Wild Wood Adventure Play (see the planning page for prices), and parking is pay and display. National Trust for Scotland members get in free and park free.
